audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Skill/Lucian — Lucian winning five stages including 2+ items — against a 28.57% win rate and against this file's own whys, which say Shen out-trades from 4-5 and 'hard out-stats' late.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Lucian, Lucian, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen) matches the prose exactly: whys[0] 'fine but not dominant', whys[1]/[2] Lucian's burst window, whys[3] 'he eats your poke and out-trades you now', whys[4] global R erases the lead, whys[5] first tank item outpaces you, whys[6] hard out-stats.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Lucian / Lucian / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen in both layers with matching ratings and whys.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 2 Lucian burst, Lvl 3 weave window, Lvl 6 global Stand United, 2+ items Spirit's Refuge blanking DPS. Ordering and ownership both match the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states where Spirit's Refuge actually sits, or which of Lucian's damage it stops.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' The zone is anchored on the spirit blade, not on Shen — so you walk away from the blade, not from Shen, and Twilight Assault recalling the blade moves where the safe ground is. It blocks attacks, which means autos and the Lightslinger double-shot; Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze are abilities, not attacks, so they go through. That distinction is the entire trading pattern here and it appears nowhere in the full layer.
audit.corrected: Blade-anchoring written into report[5].t; the Q/W-are-not-attacks point into dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d gave no numbers for Shadow Dash.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s, 600 range, 150 energy; Spirit's Refuge is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 400 range. The 600-range taunt versus your 445-range dash is why you cannot simply dash out of a taunt already in flight.
diff HARD, diffRating 7/10 and breakdown.difficulty 'Tricky matchup' are mutually consistent here and consistent with 28.57%. No change needed.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Neither dominates — you poke from 500 range, but Ki Barrier shields him after every cast and he only wants to farm.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Shadow Dash (Taunt) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge drops toward 13s and blanks every auto inside it — his sustain eats the poke and he out-trades you now.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Stand United is global — he presses it off your wave, wins a fight elsewhere, and your CS lead stops paying.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first tank item plus a 400-range Spirit's Refuge outpaces your spike — the burst is blocked, not merely survived.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Full-tank Shen blanks your autos at the blade and taunts your low HP — group and peel, never sidelane into him.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash: 18/16/14/12/10s, 600 range, 150 energy — it out-ranges your 445 dash, so punish only while it is down. Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1. - Your E dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 and 600 range — until it is spent, every step you take is a coin flip.

edits.before: Shen spends Shadow Dash (Taunt) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze are not attacks — the blade zone never blocks them.

edits.before: Track Shen’s Shadow Dash (Taunt): His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge sits on his spirit blade, not on Shen — walk off the blade and your autos land while he stands in it.

notes: Spirit's Refuge blocks 'attacks', so autos and Lightslinger double-shots are stopped and Piercing Light / Ardent Blaze are not — that much is directly in Riot's text and is now on the page. Whether The Culling's shots count as attacks for the block is NOT in the kit text and I did not assert it either way; content's whys[5] only says it 'barely dents his armor', which is safe. Recorded in unverified. Shen's costs are energy (Q 140/130/120/110/100, E 150) — I used the raw numbers and did not claim anything about his energy pool, which is not in the file. diffRating 7/10 with diff HARD is the consistent convention on this page; other lucian matchups use it inconsistently (see notes on sett and sejuani).
